title: Algerian Chicken Stir Fry
description: A keto-friendly stir fry dish made with chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Algerian spices.
instructions: Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add Algerian spice blend to skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add crispy lettuce and crunchy cucumber to skillet and cook until slightly wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken to skillet and stir to combine with vegetables.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional crunchy cucumber if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of sour cream or raita to add extra creaminess.
